ms.promise:
Multiparty Computation as a Layer 2 service to Cardano 
(Read more here about the technical approach and see illustration below)
Milestone 3:
・Smart contract in Cardano instructs their users to input their secret into the PBC Smart contract
・This is an initial step in the `demonstration of confidential and privacy-preserving analytics conducted on a selected dataset`. The initiator/user requesting a dataset (personal, demographic data) to be analysed, identifies the dataset, and initiates the MPC process with this step through the contract in Milestone 2. Then in Milestone 4 the data is analysed and the results presented. 
・﻿(we broke the proposal milestones down further into simpler steps to align to Partisia teams feedback on the process)
・Documentation and video of milestone 3

For reference:
Milestone 1: Write a smart contract in Cardano (Update Profila existing Aiken data subscription smart contract)
Milestone 2: Write a smart contract in the Partisia Blockchain
Milestone 4: Computation is done in the PBC infrastructure, and output is sent back
ms.criteria:

・Documentation will be provided in PDF format in English. 
・Documentation will include the data type and data definition and the process of sharing the secret into the PBC smart contract.
・Video of the process will be uploaded in YouTube
・Video will include demo of the process as executed on the PBC testnet.
ms.report:
Milestone 3: Define a dataset and share the secret into the Partisia MPC smart contract
Acceptance Criteria & Evidence:
1. A dataset is defined by a user, demonstrated as a data input, typically personal data and demographics which require analysis but in a privacy-preserving manner. This data source will be defined and is test data from the Profila platform.
50 synthetic test users representing Profila platform data (ages 14-75, survey responses, country codes). Secret fields: age (Sbi64) and survey_q1_answer (Sbi64). Distribution: 35 users over age 18, 28 with survey=true. No real PII - synthetic data only.
Test dataset: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/test-data/profila_test_users.json
2. Documentation provided in PDF format in English
Link: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/docs/evidence/milestone-3-report.pdf
3. Documentation includes the data type and data definition and the process of sharing the secret into the PBC smart contract
Data types and secret sharing process documented in PDF (Sections 3-4). Secret submission uses official Partisia Blockchain TypeScript SDK - each secret is encrypted and shared across 4 MPC nodes via RealZkClient. No individual values are ever exposed.
Secret submission script: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/relay/submit_secrets.ts
Submission log (5 on-chain ZK transactions, no raw values logged): https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/relay/secret-submissions-log.json
4. Video of the process uploaded to YouTube
M3 Demo: https://youtu.be/psm2lMU7n1o
5. Video includes demo of the process as executed on the PBC testnet
PBC contract on testnet (community can verify): https://browser.testnet.partisiablockchain.com/contracts/039ed9214602f2a93eb05411f852fa78a476607634
Privacy verification evidence: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/relay/m3-state-evidence.json
Evidence of Milestone Completion:
Documentation (PDF): https://github.co

ms.promise:
Multiparty Computation as a Layer 2 service to Cardano 
(Read more here about the technical approach and see illustration below)
Milestone 4: 
・Computation is done in the PBC infrastructure, and output is sent back
・The output is the result of the query(ies) in milestone 3 ie. No. of individuals over the age of 18. People who answered a specific survey question the same. This resultant output is achieved across multiple data sources without the data being exposed.
・The resultant analysis will be displayed as a simple dataset in this concept. In future this end to end process would be implemented into a platform like Profila, where the UI of making a query on a dataset and seeing the result graphically or within a process (like creating lists of similar people without seeing their data) will be possible.
・Documentation and video of milestone 4

ms.report:
Milestone 4: Display the result of a MPC query and final closeout
Acceptance Criteria & Evidence:
・The result (dataset) of a MPC query will be documented and displayed to the initiator

MPC computation result: 5 (5 out of 5 submitted users have age > 18). Result fetched from live PBC contract state via REST API and displayed via terminal output and HTML evidence page. Aggregate result only - no individual data exposed.
MPC result: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/relay/mpc-result.json
Result display script: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/relay/show_result.ts
・Documentation provided in PDF format in English

Link: https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/docs/evidence/milestone-4-report.pdf
・Documentation includes the definition of the final process of displaying the result of a MPC query

The process: show_result.ts calls PBC REST API, receives serialized contract state, decodes ProfilaMpcState binary, extracts aggregate result, displays in terminal and generates HTML evidence page with cross-chain links.
E2E run log (full 6-stage pipeline): https://github.com/Profila/Aiken-Partisia_MPC/blob/main/docs/evidence/e2e-run-log.json
